summary: We are seeking a proactive and highly motivated 'Full Stack Intern' to join our engineering team. This role is designed for individuals looking to gain hands-on experience in both frontend and backend development while working on real-world product features, internal tools, and scalable applications.
responsibilities: Assist in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable web applications.
Collaborate with the frontend and backend teams to implement new features.
Write clean, efficient, and modular code following best practices.
Work with APIs, perform integrations, and troubleshoot issues.
Participate in team meetings, code reviews, and daily stand-ups.
Document technical work and contribute to internal knowledge bases.
Support QA and testing efforts by identifying and fixing bugs.
